A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

, for co-channel femto deployment in a 3-sector hierarchical macrocell network, the femto DL transmission should be stopped inside the femto exclusion region (FER), and the femto DL power should be controlled according to the femto users' location within the macrocell coverage.

the femto DL power is controlled by a distributed scheme to avoid co-channel femto transmissions inside the FEM, and the macro DL power is controlled in a coordinated manner to reduce macro DL interference to femtocells outside of the FER.

, the femtocell DL OP is a function of the femto users' location and the femto DL power, and the femtocell users' DL OPs can be improved by controlling the femto DL transmission power according to femtocell users’ locations.

co-channel femtocells can be deployed in hierarchical 3-sectors macrocells without causing excessive DL OP degradation for both femto and macro users.
